reason: The brand's typeface (Phase 1). SIL Open Font License 1.1: fonts may be bundled with any software, AGPL included; the font stays under the OFL. Its package.json names the license in prose, not SPDX.

Through ut_pex (the torrent engine's peer exchange, ADR 0037). Its package.json says "BSD" without a variant and its README's Licence section says MIT (github.com/bencevans/node-compact2string); either is permissive and compatible with AGPL-3.0.
